gen-gf-underdog-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text reads friendly and modern, its curves leaving their ends open so each word goes down easily. And Underdog up top is the loud one, every stroke as heavy as its stems, so the body can be set a touch larger without losing ground.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau: Underdog draws its letters like toothpaste squeezed out in one steady line, with a c that gapes wide like a horseshoe. Ysabeau follows in a plain sans, sweeping curves that never close up, so the heading's bold stroke has a gentle partner underneath.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-infant: Chunky, outlined and unshaded. Underdog earns its keep when it goes big and short, where that steady stroke and wide horseshoe c can stand out, and Ysabeau Infant adds sans terminals that flick outward like tongs.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office reads open and modern, every curved letter ending in a gap that lets the eye slip through. But Underdog has no thick-thin pulse at all, so over a longer stretch the body supplies the rhythm and the heading just holds steady.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-sc: Underdog glides under the eye like wire, its horseshoe c gaping wide and its commanding stroke never varying in weight. Ysabeau SC has that gaping c too.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans reads approachable and level, curves left open at every end. Underdog's rounded-wire stroke is built for loud, expressive display lines, while the plain sans simply carries the sentences that follow without fuss.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Wire-bright and bold, Underdog keeps one constant pen width from stem to curve. But Zalando Sans Expanded spreads out below it, a sparse row of wide-gapped letters that feels cool and spacious beside the heading's chunky swagger.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpa: Underdog holds a unit-width stroke throughout, with a horseshoe c that is hard to forget. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves on c, e and s, and that contrast in character is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Zero thick-thin contrast and a c opened wide like a horseshoe mark Underdog as the loud one. And ZCOOL XiaoWei answers with the mild weight shifts of a gently used dip pen, which gives the pair its strongest quality: a stiff, uniform line meeting a softly varied one.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiq: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads modern and clean, with a smooth path around each bend and a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight. Underdog does best at commanding, expressive display size, while Zen Kaku Gothic Antique does best at quiet, steady text.
